meta.description: Recipe database for the meal plan. Edit this file; keep valid JSON. IDs are stable dish names (no day of week) so entries can be reused or moved on the calendar.

recipes.title: Lemon Pepper Tofu and Asparagus
recipes.notes: Added brown rice as complex carb side. Nutrition estimated from USDA values.
ingredients: 1 (450g) block super firm tofu, cut into slabs
steps: Cook 1 cup brown rice according to package directions.

Set oven to 425°F. Add trimmed asparagus to a lined baking sheet and top with a small splash of avocado oil, 1/2 tbsp nutritional yeast, black pepper, salt, and juice of half a lemon. Toss to coat and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Combine cornstarch, 2 tbsp nutritional yeast, pepper, thyme, and salt in a dish. Coat tofu pieces in the mixture.
Warm avocado oil in a large skillet. When hot, add tofu and cook 3-5 minutes per side until golden.
While tofu cooks, combine lemon juice, zest, maple syrup, black pepper, vegetable broth, and 1 tsp cornstarch in a bowl.

Remove cooked tofu from pan. Add a teaspoon of oil and sauté garlic and red pepper flakes until fragrant. Pour in sauce and cook 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened. Add tofu back and coat with sauce.
Serve tofu and asparagus over brown rice.

recipes.title: Crunchy Thai Peanut & Quinoa Salad
recipes.notes: Added pan-fried tofu for protein boost. Nutrition estimated from USDA values.
ingredients: 1 (14 oz) block extra-firm tofu, pressed and cubed
steps: Rinse quinoa. Combine with 1.5 cups water in a pot, bring to a gentle boil, reduce heat and simmer 10-15 minutes until water is absorbed. Cover and rest 5 minutes, then fluff.
Press tofu and cut into cubes. Heat avocado oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Pan-fry tofu 3-4 minutes per side until golden and crispy. Set aside.
Whisk peanut butter and tamari until smooth. Add maple syrup, rice vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, lime juice, and red pepper flakes. Whisk until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, cabbage, carrot, snow peas, cilantro, and green onion. Add tofu. Pour peanut sauce over and toss to coat.
Divide into bowls and garnish with chopped peanuts.

recipes.title: Turkey Enchilada Quinoa Soup
recipes.notes: Reduced cheese to 1/2 cup reduced-fat cheddar. Added kale for extra greens. Nutrition estimated.
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cooked turkey (or chicken breast)
1 (14 oz) can black beans, drained and rinsed
Diced avocado, cilantro, and tortilla chips for serving
steps: Heat olive oil in a large stockpot over medium-high heat. Add onion and sweet potato, season with salt and pepper, and cook 5-8 minutes until softened.
Pour in chicken broth, enchilada sauce, green chiles, and 1 cup water. Bring to a boil.
Add quinoa, cover, reduce heat to low, and cook 15 minutes until quinoa is soft.
Stir in turkey, black beans, kale, and 1/2 cup cheddar. Cook until cheese is melted, kale is wilted, and turkey is warmed through, about 5 minutes.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with avocado, cilantro, and tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Grilled Pork Tenderloin with Wilted Greens & Peach Vinaigrette
recipes.notes: Reduced vinaigrette oil to 1/3 cup, swapped vegetable oil in marinade to 2 tbsp avocado oil, added farro as complex carb. Nutrition estimated.
steps: Cook farro according to package directions (typically simmer 25-30 minutes). Drain and set aside.
Whisk soy sauce, avocado oil, honey, ginger, and garlic for the marinade. Add pork, cover, and refrigerate 6 hours to overnight.
For vinaigrette, blend lemon juice, red wine vinegar, Dijon, and peach preserves. Slowly stream in 1/3 cup olive oil to emulsify. Season with salt and pepper.
Slice onion into thick rings. Brush with oil, season with salt and pepper.

Preheat grill to high (500-600°F). Grill pork and onions 7 minutes, flip, cook 6 more minutes, then turn off burners and rest with lid closed 5 minutes. Transfer to cutting board and rest 5 more minutes.
Toss warm onions, arugula, peach, and avocado with peach vinaigrette.
Slice pork against the grain. Serve over farro with salad alongside.

recipes.title: Blackened Tilapia with Avocado Cucumber Salsa
recipes.notes: Reduced butter to 2 tbsp. Added quinoa side and sautéed spinach. Nutrition estimated.
steps: Cook quinoa: rinse 1 cup quinoa, combine with 2 cups water, bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15 minutes. Fluff with fork.
Heat a large cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking hot.
Pat tilapia dry. Coat each fillet in blackening seasoning, pressing spices into the fish.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in skillet. Cook tilapia 2 minutes per side until cooked through and flaky.
Mix avocado, cucumber, parsley, lemon juice, and salt in a small bowl for salsa.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tsp olive oil over medium heat. Add spinach and cook 2-3 minutes until wilted. Season with salt.
Serve blackened tilapia over quinoa with avocado cucumber salsa and sautéed spinach alongside.

recipes.title: Mushroom Barley Soup
recipes.notes: Added cannellini beans for protein boost. Nutrition estimated.
ingredients: 16 oz baby bella mushrooms, halved or sliced
1 (15 oz) can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add baby bella mushrooms and cook until they gain color, about 5 minutes. Season with salt. Remove and set aside.
In the same pot, add more olive oil. Add onion, garlic, celery, carrot, and chopped white mushrooms. Cook 4-5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Add crushed tomatoes, coriander, smoked paprika, and cumin. Cook 3 minutes, stirring regularly.
Add broth and pearl barley. Bring to a rolling boil for 5 minutes, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer 30 minutes until barley is tender.
Stir in cannellini beans and reserved bella mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes until warmed through.
Finish with fresh parsley. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Lentil Stew with Quinoa and Mushrooms
recipes.notes: No tweaks needed. Nutrition sourced from recipe page.
ingredients: 2 large carrots, peeled and cut into 1/3-inch rounds
8 oz cremini and/or shiitake mushrooms, sliced
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, celery, carrots, mushrooms, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are soft and beginning to brown, about 10 minutes.
Add stock, 2 cups water, and diced tomatoes. Increase heat to high and bring to a boil.
Add lentils, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook until lentils begin to soften, about 12 minutes.
Increase heat to high, add quinoa, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until lentils and quinoa are tender, about 20 minutes more.
Discard thyme stems. Ladle into bowls. Drizzle with balsamic vinegar if desired.

recipes.title: 20-Minute Moroccan Chickpea Soup
recipes.notes: Added quinoa cooked in the broth for protein and carb boost. Nutrition estimated.
ingredients: 2 (15 oz) cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed
Pinch of crushed red pepper flakes
Kosher salt and black pepper to taste
Chopped fresh cilantro and lemon wedges for serving
steps: Heat oil in a large stockpot over medium-high heat. Add onion and carrot, sauté 5 minutes until onion is soft. Add garlic and sauté 1 more minute.
Add vegetable stock, chickpeas, tomatoes, tomato paste, cumin, cinnamon, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Stir in quinoa. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low. Simmer 15 minutes until quinoa is cooked.
Stir in kale and continue simmering 3 minutes until kale softens.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve garnished with cilantro and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Quinoa Bowls
recipes.notes: No tweaks needed. Already uses chicken breast, quinoa, and plenty of veggies. Nutrition estimated.
ingredients: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, divided
steps: Rinse quinoa. Toast in a dry saucepan a few minutes, then add 1.5 cups water and bring to a boil. Reduce to low, cover with lid slightly ajar, and simmer 12-13 minutes until fluffy.
Pound chicken to 1/4-inch thickness. Combine cumin, paprika, turmeric, cayenne, lemon juice, garlic, and 1 tbsp olive oil. Coat chicken and marinate at least 10 minutes.
Season chicken with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook chicken 3-4 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F. Rest, then slice.
Chop onion, bell pepper, cucumber, and tomatoes. Toss with lemon juice, 2 tbsp olive oil, and parsley.
Make tahini sauce: whisk tahini, lemon juice, garlic, then slowly add warm water until thin and saucy. Season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Assemble bowls: quinoa base, topped with veggies and sliced chicken. Drizzle with tahini sauce. Serve with warmed naan.

recipes.title: Healthy Southwest Chicken Taco Salad
recipes.notes: Added quinoa as complex carb. Already uses chicken breast. Nutrition estimated.
ingredients: 1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed
Cotija or feta cheese for topping
steps: Cook quinoa: rinse 1 cup quinoa, combine with 2 cups water, bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, simmer 15 minutes. Fluff and set aside.
Whisk olive oil, lime juice, and all spices in a bowl. Add chicken, toss to coat, and marinate at least 20 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 4-6 minutes per side until internal temp is 165°F. Let rest, then slice.
Make jalapeño ranch: blend Greek yogurt, jalapeño, olive oil, lime juice, cilantro, dill, garlic, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Assemble salads: romaine base, topped with quinoa, sliced chicken, black beans, corn, tomatoes, avocado, red onion, and crumbled cheese. Drizzle with jalapeño ranch.

recipes.title: 1-Pot Spiced Sweet Potato Lentil Soup
recipes.notes: Added chickpeas for protein boost. Use low-sodium broth to reduce sodium. Nutrition estimated.
ingredients: 1 cup brown or green lentils, rinsed
1 large sweet potato, peeled and chopped
1 (15 oz) can chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Optional: soak lentils overnight for improved digestibility. Rinse and drain before using.
Heat a large pot over medium-high heat. Add water and onion, sauté 5 minutes until slightly browned.
Add garlic and sauté 1 minute. Add sweet potato, salt, pepper, cumin, cinnamon, coriander, turmeric, and cayenne. Stir and cook 4 minutes.
Add vegetable broth (start with 5 cups) and bring to a low boil. Add lentils, chickpeas, and coconut sugar. Stir to combine.
Once boiling, reduce to a simmer, loosely cover, and cook about 20 minutes until lentils are tender.
Add green beans, stir, and cover. Cook 10 more minutes. Rest 5 minutes off heat.
Taste and adjust seasonings. Serve topped with fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Herb Grilled Salmon with Farro and Asparagus
recipes.notes: Paired with farro and roasted asparagus. Salmon cholesterol is acceptable (omega-3 rich). Nutrition estimated.
ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil, plus more for grill
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
steps: Cook farro: combine with 3 cups water and a pinch of salt, bring to boil, reduce heat, simmer 25-30 minutes until tender. Drain any excess water.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss asparagus with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast 12-15 minutes until tender and slightly charred.
Whisk lemon juice, 1/4 cup olive oil, parsley, rosemary, thyme, garlic, lemon zest, Dijon, honey, 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper.
Place salmon in a dish, pour marinade over, cover, and refrigerate 30 minutes (turn once halfway through).
Preheat grill to medium-high. Clean and oil grates. Grill salmon 3-5 minutes per side until cooked to preference.
Serve salmon over farro with roasted asparagus alongside. Garnish with extra parsley.

recipes.title: Mixed Greens Salad with White Beans, Chicken & Dijon Vinaigrette
recipes.notes: Swapped chicken thighs to chicken breast. Added quinoa for complex carb. Nutrition estimated.
ingredients: 1 (15 oz) can white beans (cannellini), drained and rinsed
steps: Cook quinoa: rinse, combine with 2 cups water, bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, simmer 15 minutes. Fluff and let cool slightly.
Season chicken breast with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 5-6 minutes per side until internal temp is 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Make vinaigrette: whisk Dijon, red wine vinegar, olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper until emulsified.
Assemble salads: mixed greens base, topped with quinoa, sliced chicken, white beans, tomatoes, cucumber, avocado, and pepitas. Drizzle with Dijon vinaigrette.

recipes.title: Roasted Veggie Glow Bowls
recipes.notes: Added roasted tofu for protein boost per user request. Nutrition estimated.
ingredients: 1 (14 oz) block extra-firm tofu, pressed and cubed
1 medium head cauliflower, cut into florets (about 6 cups)
3 large carrots, peeled and sliced diagonally into 1-inch chunks
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Press tofu and cut into cubes.
Add cauliflower, carrots, and tofu cubes to a large rimmed baking sheet. Toss with 2 tbsp olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Roast 25-30 minutes, tossing once halfway through, until veggies are caramelized and tofu is crispy on edges.

Meanwhile, combine quinoa and broth in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15 minutes until liquid is absorbed. Remove lid, stir in kale and remaining 1 tbsp olive oil. Cover and keep warm (residual heat will wilt the kale).
Prepare golden tahini dressing: combine tahini, sherry vinegar, maple syrup, chili garlic sauce, curry powder, turmeric, and salt. Whisk in water 1 tbsp at a time until smooth and pourable.
Divide quinoa-kale mixture between 4 bowls. Top with roasted veggies and tofu. Add avocado slices, drizzle with tahini dressing, and sprinkle pumpkin seeds and parsley on top.

recipes.title: Steel-Cut Oats Bowl
recipes.notes: Simple high-fiber breakfast. Nutrition estimated from USDA values.
steps: Cook steel-cut oats according to package directions (typically 1 cup water per 1/3 cup oats, simmer 20-25 minutes).
Top with diced apple, chia seeds, flaxseed meal, almonds, and peanut butter.
Serve with coffee and low-fat milk on the side or stirred in.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Snack Bowl
recipes.notes: Quick high-protein snack. Nutrition estimated from USDA values.
steps: Scoop Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with diced apple, slivered almonds, peanut butter, and oatmeal squares cereal.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese & Mandarins Snack
recipes.notes: Simple high-protein snack. Nutrition estimated from USDA values.
steps: Scoop cottage cheese into a bowl.
Peel mandarins and arrange alongside or on top.
Sprinkle almonds over the top.

recipes.title: Open-Faced Egg & Avocado Toast
recipes.notes: Quick high-protein breakfast. Nutrition estimated from USDA values.
steps: Toast whole grain bread.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook egg and egg whites (scrambled or fried, as preferred).
Spread mashed avocado on toast. Top with cooked eggs and tomato slices. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve with coffee and low-fat milk.

recipes.title: Veggie Egg Scramble + Toast
recipes.notes: High-protein veggie-packed breakfast. Nutrition estimated from USDA values.
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced bell pepper and mushrooms
steps: Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Sauté bell pepper and mushrooms 3-4 minutes until softened.
Whisk egg and egg whites together. Pour into skillet with veggies and scramble until cooked through. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve scramble with whole grain toast alongside. Enjoy with coffee and low-fat milk.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Dal
recipes.notes: Based on NYT recipe. Includes quinoa and roti for carbs, kale for greens, yogurt for extra protein. Nutrition estimated.
steps: Cook quinoa: rinse, combine with 2 cups water, bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, simmer 15 minutes. Fluff and set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook 5 minutes until softened.
Add sweet potato, fresh ginger, garlic, and serrano pepper. Cook 2-3 minutes until fragrant.

Stir in red lentils, coriander, cumin, turmeric, and ground ginger. Add diced tomatoes and 2 cups water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 20-25 minutes until lentils are soft and broken down.
Stir in chopped kale and cook 3-5 minutes until wilted. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve dal over quinoa with warmed roti on the side. Top each serving with 1 tbsp cilantro, 1 tbsp diced red onion, and 1/4 cup Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Hummus and Carrots
recipes.notes: Simple grab-and-go snack. Nutrition estimated from USDA values.
steps: Portion hummus into a small bowl or container. Serve with carrots for dipping.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Shake
recipes.notes: Makes 2 servings. Nutrition is per serving. Estimated from USDA values.
steps: Add almond milk, banana, protein powder, cocoa powder, frozen blueberries, and peanut butter to a blender.
Blend until smooth. Divide between two glasses.

recipes.title: Quinoa Chickpea Salad with Roasted Red Pepper Hummus Dressing
recipes.notes: Doubled chickpeas to boost protein above 20g. Single-serving recipe scaled to 2. Nutrition estimated.
ingredients: 1 (15 oz) can chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Cook quinoa if not already prepared (1/2 cup dry quinoa with 1 cup water, simmer 15 minutes).
Divide mixed greens between 2 bowls. Top each with quinoa and chickpeas.
Whisk hummus with lemon juice until smooth and pourable (add a splash of water if needed). Drizzle over salads.
Top with roasted red pepper, sunflower seeds, and parsley. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Oven Roasted Salmon with Braised French Lentils
recipes.notes: Added roasted broccolini as vegetable side. Salmon cholesterol acceptable (omega-3 rich). Nutrition estimated.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F.

Pat salmon dry. Combine garlic, thyme, mustard, lemon zest, 3 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper for marinade. Brush bottom of fillets, place on parchment-lined sheet pan, spoon remaining marinade over tops. Set aside.
For lentils: heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add onion, celery, and carrot; cook 8-10 minutes until softened. Add garlic and lentils, cook 2 minutes.
Add wine, let cook off 2 minutes. Pour in stock, salt, and mustard. Bring to a simmer. Add bay leaves and thyme sprigs. Cover and simmer on low 25-30 minutes until lentils are tender.
When lentils have about 12 minutes remaining, place salmon in oven. Bake 10-15 minutes depending on thickness.
Meanwhile, toss broccolini with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast at 425°F for 10-12 minutes until tender-crisp (can share oven with salmon at end, or roast separately).
Remove bay leaves and thyme sprigs from lentils. Taste and adjust salt. Serve lentils in shallow bowls, topped with salmon and broccolini alongside.

recipes.title: Lentil Veggie Bowls with Tahini Sauce
recipes.notes: Protein meets threshold at ~22g from lentils and seeds. No tweaks needed. Nutrition from recipe page (without tahini sauce).
ingredients: 1.5 cups dry lentils (brown, green, or black)
2 cups dark leafy greens (spinach, arugula, or kale)
steps: Cook lentils in ample salted water until tender (15-25 minutes depending on size). Drain.
Season lentils with olive oil, salt, cumin, chili flakes, and a squeeze of lemon.
Roast cauliflower at 400°F with olive oil, salt, and pepper for 20 minutes.
Make tahini sauce: whisk tahini with water, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Prep veggies: shred carrots, slice bell pepper, wash greens.
Assemble bowls: warm lentils as base, top with roasted cauliflower, greens, veggies, and herbs. Drizzle generously with tahini sauce and sprinkle with seeds.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Lentil Salad
recipes.notes: Serve in 2-cup portions with 1/2 cup cooked quinoa per serving to boost protein to ~20g. Nutrition estimated with quinoa addition.
ingredients: 1 cup dry lentils (French green, black, or brown)
steps: Cook lentils in salted water until al dente (15-20 minutes). Drain and cool.
Cook quinoa: combine 1/2 cup quinoa with 1 cup water, bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, simmer 15 minutes. Fluff.
Prep cucumbers, tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, mint, and parsley. Place in a large bowl.
Add cooled lentils and quinoa to the bowl.
Grate garlic over bowl, add lemon zest, juice, olive oil, salt, pepper, and cumin. Toss well to combine.
Taste and adjust salt and lemon. Serve as-is or over baby arugula.

recipes.title: Mujadara (Lentils and Rice)
recipes.notes: Serve with 1/4 cup Greek yogurt per serving for protein boost to ~20g. Add a simple side salad for veggies. Nutrition estimated with yogurt.
ingredients: 1 cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt (for serving)
Diced tomato, avocado, fresh parsley for garnish
steps: Soak lentils in hot water while prepping other ingredients.
Set Instant Pot to sauté. Cook shallots in oil 4-5 minutes until caramelized. Remove half for topping.
Add garlic, sauté 1-2 minutes. Add all spices, salt, lemon zest, and water. Stir.
Drain lentils and add with rinsed rice to the pot. Stir.
Set to High Pressure for 11 minutes. Natural release 10 minutes.
Fluff gently with a fork. Serve in bowls drizzled with olive oil, topped with reserved caramelized shallots, tomato, avocado, and a dollop of Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Chicken Cabbage Stir Fry
recipes.notes: Added brown rice as complex carb side. Uses ground chicken (lean). Nutrition estimated with rice.
steps: Cook brown rice according to package directions.
Whisk stir-fry sauce: soy sauce, maple syrup, Shaoxing wine, sesame oil, chili sauce, and cornstarch.
Heat cast iron pan to medium-high. Add oil and ground chicken, season with salt and pepper. Break into pieces and cook 4 minutes. Set aside.
In same pan, stir-fry cabbage in batches over medium-high heat, 5-10 minutes until edges are lightly charred.
Push cabbage aside, add oil, shallot, ginger, garlic, and dried chilis. Sauté 2 minutes, then mix into cabbage.
Add white parts of green onions and cooked chicken. Whisk sauce again and pour in. Cook 2-3 minutes.
Serve over brown rice, garnished with green onion tops and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: White Chicken Chili
recipes.notes: Use chicken breast only (not thighs). White beans serve as carb. Nutrition sourced from recipe page.
ingredients: 3 cups cooked white beans (2 x 14-oz cans, drained)
Garnishes: sour cream, avocado, lime wedges
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion, garlic, and poblano peppers 8 minutes until tender.
Add cumin, coriander, and chili powder. Toast 1 minute.
Add broth, soy sauce, vinegar, oregano, and salt. Add whole chicken breasts. Bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce to low, simmer 20-30 minutes until chicken shreds easily.
Shred chicken with two forks, return to pot.
Add white beans and juice of 1 lime. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes.
Stir in half the cilantro. Taste and adjust salt, lime, and heat. Serve with garnishes.

recipes.title: Lentil Turkey Sausage Soup
recipes.notes: Uses homemade turkey sausage seasoning (not processed meat). No tweaks needed. Nutrition sourced from recipe page.
steps: Mix ground turkey with salt, pepper, sage, red pepper flakes, fennel, marjoram, and onion powder.
Heat olive oil in a large pot. Sauté onion 2-3 minutes. Add seasoned turkey, cook until browned. Add garlic, sauté 1 minute.
Add celery, carrots, cauliflower, rosemary, smoked paprika, bay leaf, salt, pepper, tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, and lentils.
Bring to a boil, reduce to simmer 20-25 minutes until lentils are tender.
Stir in red wine vinegar. Adjust salt and pepper. Serve garnished with parsley.

recipes.title: Miso Salmon Bowls
recipes.notes: No tweaks needed. Salmon cholesterol acceptable (omega-3 rich). Nutrition sourced from recipe page.
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillets, skinless, cut into 1-inch cubes
Cilantro, scallions, sesame seeds for garnish
steps: Cook brown rice according to package directions.
Make miso dressing: blend olive oil, sesame oil, rice vinegar, maple syrup, miso paste, soy sauce, water, garlic, ginger, salt, and cayenne until smooth.
Roast shiitakes: remove stems, brush with miso dressing, roast at 450°F for 15-20 minutes.
Season salmon cubes with 5-spice, garlic powder, onion powder, ginger, pepper, cayenne, sugar, and salt.
Air fry salmon at 400°F for 3 minutes, flip, cook 2 more minutes. (Or pan-sear 3 min per side.)
Assemble bowls: divide rice between 4 bowls, arrange shiitakes, edamame, avocado, cabbage, and salmon. Drizzle with miso dressing. Garnish with cilantro, scallions, and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Chana Masala
recipes.notes: Ghee in small amount (2-3 tbsp total for 6-8 servings) is acceptable — not a primary fat source. Serve with basmati rice and Greek yogurt for protein boost. Add spinach or side salad for greens. Nutrition estimated with rice and yogurt.
ingredients: 1.5 cups dried chickpeas, soaked (or 4-5 cups canned, drained)
2 cups water (or 1/2 cup if using canned)
1-2 tsp honey or sugar if needed
1 cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt (for serving)
steps: If using dry chickpeas, soak 8-12 hours. Drain.
Cook basmati rice according to package directions.
Heat ghee in Instant Pot on sauté. Add bay leaves, cumin seeds, and fennel seeds, stir 2-3 minutes.
Add shallots, sauté until golden. Add garlic, ginger, and jalapeño, sauté 2-3 minutes.
Add all ground spices (garam masala, cumin, coriander, chili powder, fenugreek, turmeric). Stir.
Add tomatoes, stir 3 minutes until breaking down. Add water, salt, and drained chickpeas.
Pressure cook on High 25 minutes (soaked) or 6 minutes (canned). Natural release 15 min.
Stir in baby spinach until wilted. Taste and adjust salt. Add honey if bitter.
Serve over basmati rice with a dollop of Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken and White Bean Soup
recipes.notes: Uses chicken breast. Added kale for greens. Nutrition estimated with kale addition.
steps: Set Instant Pot to sauté. Add oil, onion, celery, and garlic. Sauté 5 minutes until fragrant.
Add rosemary, bay leaf, dried beans, whole chicken breasts, stock, salt, and pepper.
Set to High Pressure 30 minutes. Natural or manual release.
Shred chicken with two forks. Stir in chopped kale and let wilt 3-5 minutes.
Add a squeeze of lemon. Taste and adjust salt and pepper.
Serve garnished with fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Mind-Blowing Vegan Bean Chili
recipes.notes: Serve over 1/2 cup cooked quinoa per serving for protein boost to ~20g. Nutrition estimated with quinoa.
ingredients: 3 x 14 oz cans beans (black, pinto, kidney — drained)
steps: Cook quinoa: rinse, combine with 2 cups water, bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, simmer 15 minutes. Set aside.
Sauté onion in olive oil over medium-high heat until golden. Lower heat, add carrots, celery, and garlic, sauté 5 more minutes.
Add bell pepper and sweet potato, season with 1/2 tsp salt, cook 10 minutes until tender.
Add spices (chili powder, cumin, coriander, oregano, paprika, cayenne, cinnamon). Toast 1-2 minutes.
Add tomatoes, beans, and broth. Cover and simmer on medium-low 10 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, soy sauce, cocoa powder, chipotle, maple syrup, and optional ground walnuts.
Taste and adjust salt, spices, or sweetness. Serve over quinoa with avocado and cilantro.

recipes.title: Moroccan Lentil Salad
recipes.notes: Serve 1.5-cup portions with 1/2 cup cooked quinoa to boost protein to ~22g. Nutrition estimated with quinoa.
ingredients: 1.5 cups dry lentils (black, brown, or green)
steps: Cook lentils in ample salted water until al dente (15-20 minutes). Drain and cool.
Cook quinoa: combine 1/2 cup with 1 cup water, bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, simmer 15 minutes. Fluff and cool.
If sensitive to raw onion, soak chopped red onion in cold salted water while prepping.
In a large bowl, combine lentils, quinoa, celery, apricots, almonds, drained onion, herbs, and orange zest. Squeeze half the orange over top.
Whisk together honey, olive oil, vinegar, garlic, salt, pepper, cumin, cinnamon, and cloves. Pour over salad and toss well.
Taste and adjust salt, lemon/orange, and chili flakes. Keeps 4 days refrigerated.

recipes.title: KIND Breakfast Bar & Almond Milk
recipes.notes: Quick grab-and-go snack. Nutrition from KIND label (2 bars/50g serving) plus 2/3 cup unsweetened almond milk.
steps: Grab a KIND bar and pour 2/3 cup almond milk into a glass.
